mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_router (menu_key, menu_path, menu_url, parent_id, "level", "rank", "show", description, is_menu, menu_type, open_type, "type", icon, name_en, name_cn, full_url) VALUES (#{menuKey}, #{menuPath}, #{menuUrl}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{rank}, true, #{description}, #{menuFlag}, #{menuType}, #{openType}, 'Custom', #{icon}, #{nameEn}, #{nameEn}, #{fullUrl});
mapper.update:
UPDATE menu_router SET menu_key = #{menuKey}, menu_path= #{menuPath}, menu_url= #{menuUrl}, parent_id= #{parentId}, "level"= #{level}, "rank"= #{rank}, "show"= #{show}, description= #{description}, is_menu= #{menuFlag}, menu_type= #{menuType}, open_type= #{openType}, icon= #{icon}
WHERE id = #{id};
mapper.select: select *, is_menu as menuFlag from menu_router order by id

with recursive tmp as (select mr.id, mr.menu_path as menuPath, mr.parent_id as parentId, mr.level, mr.description, mr.menu_key as menuKey, mr."rank", mr.is_menu as menuFlag, mr.show, mr.menu_url menuUrl, mr.menu_type menuType, mr.open_type openType, mr.type, mr.icon, mr.name_cn, mr.name_en, mr.full_url from menu_router mr, sys_role_menu srm, sys_role sr where mr.id = srm.menu_id and mr."show" = true and srm.checked = true and srm.role_id = sr.id and sr.name = #{roleName} and sr.status = true union all select mr2.id, mr2.menu_path as menuPath, mr2.parent_id as parentId, mr2.level, mr2.description, mr2.menu_key as menuKey, mr2."rank", mr2.is_menu as menuFlag, mr2.show, mr2.menu_url menuUrl, mr2.menu_type menuType, mr2.open_type openType, mr2.type, mr2.icon, mr2.name_cn, mr2.name_en, mr2.full_url from tmp, menu_router mr2 where mr2.id = tmp.parentId and mr2.show = true) select distinct tmp.* , coalesce((select srm.read_write from sys_role_menu srm, sys_role sr where tmp.id = srm.menu_id and srm.checked = true and sr.name = #{roleName} and sr.status = true and srm.read_write = true limit 1), false) as writeable from tmp

select * from menu_router
id in
#{item}

select mr2.* from menu_router mr , menu_router mr2 where mr2."rank" <= mr."rank" and mr2."rank" > #{sort} and (mr2.parent_id = 0 or mr2.parent_id is null) and mr.id = #{menuId} order by mr2.rank
select mr2.* from menu_router mr , menu_router mr2 where mr2."rank" >= mr."rank" and mr2."rank" < #{sort} and (mr2.parent_id = 0 or mr2.parent_id is null) and mr.id = #{menuId} order by mr2.rank
select rank from menu_router where parent_id = #{menuParentId} order by "rank" desc limit 1

with recursive tmp as (select mr.id, mr.menu_path as menuPath, mr.parent_id as parentId, mr.level, mr.description, mr.menu_key as menuKey, mr."rank", mr.is_menu as menuFlag, mr.show, mr.menu_url menuUrl, mr.menu_type menuType, mr.open_type openType, mr.type, mr.icon, mr.name_cn, mr.name_en, mr.full_url from menu_router mr, sys_role_menu srm, sys_role sr where mr.id = srm.menu_id and mr."show" = true and srm.checked = true and sr.id = srm.role_id and sr.status = true and sr.id = 74 union all select mr2.id, mr2.menu_path as menuPath, mr2.parent_id as parentId, mr2.level, mr2.description, mr2.menu_key as menuKey, mr2."rank", mr2.is_menu as menuFlag, mr2.show, mr2.menu_url menuUrl, mr2.menu_type menuType, mr2.open_type openType, mr2.type, mr2.icon, mr2.name_cn, mr2.name_en, mr2.full_url from tmp, menu_router mr2 where mr2.id = tmp.parentId and mr2.show = true) select distinct tmp.* , coalesce((select srm.read_write from sys_role_menu srm, sys_role sr where tmp.id = srm.menu_id and srm.checked = true and sr.id = srm.role_id and sr.id = 74 and sr.status = true and srm.read_write = true limit 1), false) as writeable from tmp
